title: Public and Private Resources in Public Safety [United States]:  Metropolitan Area Panel Data, 1977 and 1982
description:
This data collection provides a series of measures relating 
 to public safety for all SMSAs in the United States at two time 
 periods. Variables include: municipal employment (e.g. number of 
 municipal employees, number of police employees, police payrolls, 
 municipal employees per 10,000 inhabitants), municipal revenue (total 
 debt, property taxes, utility revenues, income taxes), nonmunicipal 
 employment (retail services, mining services, construction services, 
 finance services), crime rates (murder, robbery, auto theft, rape), 
 labor force and unemployment, property value, and other miscellaneous 
topics.
